name: dlptest.com
description: DLP Test site — Astro on Cloudflare Workers (prod + staging via wrangler env)

scripts.regex:validate: tsc src/lib/regex/dlp-patterns.ts --ignoreConfig --outDir .regexcheck --module es2022 --target es2022 --moduleResolution bundler --skipLibCheck && node -e "import('./.regexcheck/dlp-patterns.js').then(m=>{const f=m.validateDlpPatterns();if(f.length){console.error('INVALID PATTERNS:\n'+f.map(x=>'  '+x.id+': '+x.reason).join('\n'));process.exit(1)}console.log('OK — '+m.DLP_PATTERNS.length+' patterns valid')}).catch(e=>{console.error(e);process.exit(1)})"
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler deploy --config dist/server/wrangler.json
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run build:staging && wrangler deploy --config dist/server/wrangler.json
